tools.name: ads_budget
tools.description: Show budget status for a product: spend this month, caps, per-channel results and proposed split (budget.mjs). With record_amount and record_channel, also records actual spend in the ledger.

tools.name: ads_connectors_status
tools.description: Show which outbound connectors (ads, email, publishing, webhooks) are configured. Never prints secrets (connectors-status.mjs).

tools.name: approve_item
tools.description: Owner decision on one approval (approve or reject), applied through apply-decisions.mjs. Requires owner_token to match WHALYOM_OWNER_TOKEN from the environment that started the server (never the repo .env, which disables this tool); disable

tools.name: attach_site_status
tools.description: Show how a product is attached to its website: connection.json (secrets masked), whether the satellite secret and site repo are present (yes/no only), local static site pages, and the next attach step.

tools.name: booking_links
tools.description: Read booking links from Cal.com and Calendly event types into products/<slug>/research/booking-links.json (read-only on the platforms). dry_run defaults to true.

tools.name: build_landing
tools.description: Build landing pages for a product with tools/landing-builder.mjs into products/<slug>/landing/dist/ (claims-guarded). Does not publish: publishing goes through an approval. Use list=true to see templates.

tools.name: connector_status
tools.description: Status of one connector by name: configured, which env variable NAMES are missing, what it handles, and (with slug) whether it is usable for that product. Never returns secret values.

tools.name: experiments_summary
tools.description: Summarise experiments.json for one product or all: counts by status and verdict, running tests with metric and stop date, and recent verdicts.

tools.name: graph_snapshot
tools.description: Rebuild the live control-room snapshot (live-snapshot.mjs) and return its counts plus a size-capped excerpt of state/live-graph.json.

tools.name: growth_execute
tools.description: Execute approved/auto-approved actions through configured connectors, or write manual steps (execute.mjs). dry_run defaults to true (preview only); set false to really execute. Respects kill switches and budget caps.

tools.name: growth_policy
tools.description: Apply the product autonomy policy: turns eligible pending approvals into auto-approved (policy.mjs). Writes approvals.json.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show the Whalyom edition from the local license key (offline check; never blocks the free features, never phones home).

tools.name: list_connectors
tools.description: List every connector (executors in routing order, opt-in ad CSV exporters, read-only metrics and booking-link readers) with configured flag, missing env names and notes. Never returns secret values.

tools.name: metrics_ingest
tools.description: Ingest metrics for a product from metrics/inbox files and Stripe (if configured) into metrics/kpis.json (metrics.mjs).

tools.name: metrics_pull
tools.description: Pull read-only metrics into products/<slug>/metrics/inbox/ for metrics_ingest. Sources: ${METRIC_SOURCES.join(', ')}. Without sources every configured reader except stripe runs (stripe only when named), and the dry run previews exactly that

tools.name: nyk_build
tools.description: Build the Needs-You-Know feed (ranked owner decisions, approvals, blocked work, alerts) via needs-you-know.mjs and return its summary plus items.

tools.name: queue_task
tools.description: Queue a task for an om-* agent. Respects the single-writer rule: writes products/<slug>/runs/Q-<stamp>.json (an owner request with new_tasks) and, with apply=true, runs apply-results.mjs to merge it into tasks.json.

tools.name: results_apply
tools.description: Merge agent result files (products/<slug>/runs/*.json) into tasks.json, approvals.json and experiments.json (apply-results.mjs). Writes workspace ledgers.

tools.name: run_doctor
tools.description: Health check: validate.mjs for one product or every product; with self_debug=true also runs self-debug.mjs --no-tests (writes state/self-debug.json and raises system alerts).

tools.name: tasks_ready
tools.description: List tasks that can run now for a product (status todo, all dependencies done), as JSON (ready.mjs).

tools.name: workspace_create
tools.description: Create a new product workspace from the template (new-product.mjs). Sets preset, autonomy level, monthly budget (switches to paid mode) and currency.

tools.name: workspace_list
tools.description: List all product workspaces (products/*/product.json, excluding templates) with name, stage, budget mode, caps and currency.

tools.name: workspace_validate
tools.description: Check a product workspace for broken JSON, unknown agents, bad dependencies and stuck tasks (validate.mjs).
